parameters.jsCode: const parseRec=(v)=>{if(typeof v==='string'){try{return JSON.parse(v);}catch(e){return null;}} return (v&&typeof v==='object')?v:null;}; const j=$input.first().json; const rows=[]; for(const k of Object.keys(j||{})){ if(k.indexOf('convmsg:')!==0) continue; const m=parseRec(j[k]); if(!m) continue; const inbound=!!m.finalMessage; var chat=String(m.chatId||''); if(!chat){ var kp=String(k||'').split(':'); chat=kp.length>1?kp[kp.length-1]:''; } if(!chat) continue; const text=inbound?String(m.finalMessage):String(m.output||m.text||''); if(!text) continue; rows.push({chat:chat,name:String(m.pushName||('chat '+chat)),text:text.slice(0,140),time:m.timestamp||m.at||k.split(':')[1]||'',dir:inbound?'in':'out'}); } rows.sort((a,b)=>String(b.time).localeCompare(String(a.time))); return [{json:{total:rows.length,items:rows.slice(0,30)}}];
